results.question: Which things are we never allowed to use as predictors?
results.reason: all facts present; expected source cited
results.answer:
- Actual delay [5], taxi times [5], or delay causes [5] of the same flight as predictors.  
- Observed weather as a predictor [2].  
- Taxi times as predictors (CLAUDE.md) [4].  
- AAR/ADR values without an ASPM/official source [4].  
- The flight's own actual delays, taxi times, or delay causes [3].  
- Never use actual delays, taxi times or delay causes of the same flight as predictors [6].

results.question: What does the G2 ground handling proxy actually measure?
results.reason: all facts present; expected source cited
results.answer: The G2 ground handling proxy measures mishandled bags per 1,000 (operating carrier, Form-1) [2]. It specifically measures baggage-handling quality only - not fueling, cleaning, or turn readiness [1].
